definitions.full: H1389. gibah I. גִּבְעָה noun feminine hill — absolute גִּבְעָה 2Sam 2:25 13 t. + Ezek 6:13 (strike out Co q. v.) 1Sam 7:1 ; 2Sam 6:3-4 , (compare Dr); construct גִּבְעַת Josh 5:3 8 t. + 1Sam 10:5 (compare Dr); suffix גִּבְעָתִי Ezek 34:26 (but strike out Co), גִּבְעָתָהּ Isa 31:4 ; plural absolute גְּבָעוֺת Deut 12:2 35t.; construct גִּבְעוֺת 33:15 ; Hab 3:6 , גִּבְעֹת Gen 49:26 ; suffix גִּבְעוֺתֶיךָ Ezek 35:8 ; — hill, height, elevation , both high and low, compare Psa 148:9 גבעות וכל ההרים , 65:13 ; — 1 in ordinary prose , hill , lower than mountain Exod 17:9-10 , (E) 2Sam 2:25 ; it may be proper name in 1Sam 7:1 ; 10:10 ; 2Sam 6:3-4 , see also below II. גִּבְעָה . 2 especially as place of illicit worship כָּלגֿ ׳עַל רענן עץ כל ותחת גְּבֹהָה 1Kin 14:23 ; 2Kin 17:10 ; Jer 2:20 ; compare Deut 12:2 ; 2Kin 16:4 ; 2Chr 28:4 (these two + במות ); also Hosea 4:13 ; Jer 13:27 ; 17:2 ; Ezek 6:13 (see above). 3 very commonly || הר in poetry & prophets Deut 33:15 ; Psa 72:3 ; 114:4 ; 114:6 ; 148:9 ; Song 2:8 ; 4:6 ; Isa 2:2 , 14 ; 30:17 , 25 ; 31:4 ; 40:4 , 12 ; 41:15 ; 42:15 ; 54:10 ; 55:12 ; 65:7 ; Jer 3:23 ; 4:24 ; 16:16 ; 50:7 ; Ezek 6:3 ; 34:6 ; 35:8 ; 36:4 , 6 ; Hosea 4:13 ; 10:8 ; Josh 4:18 ; Amos 9:13 ; Micah 4:1 ; 6:1 ; Nahum 1:5 ; Hab 3:6 ; rarely in prose Deut 12:2 ; sometimes as high and majestic (poetry) ׳ג עולם Gen 49:26 ; Deut 33:15 ; Hab 3:6 ('everlasting hills'); compare also Job 15:7 ; Prov 8:25 (with adjective high , compare above); see also Jer 49:16 . 4 hills with special names , some nearly or quite = proper name, of a location, which see under the respective words: ׳ג מֹרֶה Judg 7:1 teacher's hill , in valley of Jezreel; ׳ג הָעֲרָלוֺת Josh 5:3 hill of the fore-skins ; ׳ג הָאֱלֹהִים 1Sam 10:5 (a designation of Gibeah); ׳ג הַחֲכִילָה 23:19 ; 26:1 , 3 ; ׳ג אַמָּה 2Sam 2:24 ; ׳ג הַלְּבוֺנָה Song 4:6 (i.e. hill where frankincense is grown); ׳ג גָּרֵב֑ Jer 31:39 ; ׳ג יְרוּשָׁלַם Isa 10:32 ; compare 31:4 (where || הַרצִֿיּוֺן ), Ezek 34:26 (see above) & הַגְּבָעוֺת Zeph 1:10 hills on which Jerusalem stands.
